content: We have avoided this so far, but we need to start adding some sort of module option to nova and nouveau to allow switching between them, if they are both configured on. i915/xe use force_probe to handle this, with defaults for different hw revisions, amd used some per-hw flags. Do we want to have granularity here, or just a big load nouveau for all NVIDIA by default, then add a flag to disable that, and have nova need a flag. Of course CONFIG options as well? @Danilo Krummrich @Alexandre Courbot @John Hubbard
